outcome_evidence: The robot approaches the upper drawer and closes its gripper around the handle in frames 71–78 (wrist_image). It pulls the drawer outward in frames 86–109, exposing its interior and extending it from the cabinet (image and left_ego_image). The gripper releases and withdraws in frames 110–155 while the drawer remains visibly open (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
